notes: Private transport members map to observable Socket, CONNECT, stream, status, retry timing and scoped ownership laws.
Remote demo.nats.io dependencies are replaced by isolated local brokers and controlled Socket policy tests.
Native errors use typed Effect error channels, with retained causes; exact legacy text is not the contract.
testName is the exact native test declaration; placeholders identify parameterized cases.
This artifact covers only transport-node tests, not the complete official suite.
